title: backlog.py unlanded_code counts a block-only .gitattributes commit as code at done
goal: backlog.py unlanded_code treats a commit that changes .gitattributes only between the pinned markers as content, as kblane.commit_paths does since BG-ha4u5dxz, so done does not demand a code merge request for it, with a test named unlanded_code_pinned_block that plants such a commit
repro_reason: the defect needs a planted commit that changes only the pinned block of .gitattributes in a throwaway repository, which only the new test can build; the text match only shows the lane rule is absent from backlog.py
